name: Freedom Forever
old_description: Lower bills, greater savings, and complete energy control — see how going solar changed their home.
about:
Freedom Forever is based in Henrico, Virginia. The company was founded on the principle that people should have more affordable and cleaner energy options, and it began operations with a focus on residential solar installation backed by a commitment to high-level customer service.

Freedom Forever designs and installs custom solar panel systems for homes across more than 30 states. Its services include site assessment, system design, permitting with local utilities and authorities, installation of solar modules, inverters, and battery storage, and integration with virtual power plant technology. The company also offers a proprietary financing program called Aura by Freedom Forever and works with equipment brands such as Qcells, Trina Solar, SolarEdge, Tesla, and Enphase.

The company serves residential homeowners directly and through a network of Independent Authorized Dealers. Customer examples include families in Colorado, Illinois, and Massachusetts who have reduced utility bills and gained energy independence.

Freedom Forever differentiates itself with a 25-year production guarantee that compensates customers if their system underperforms, a commitment to 5-star customer service, and advocacy partnerships that promote solar education and research.

name: Freedom Medical Supply
old_description: Quality service with quality products all in a comfortable and professional setting.
about:
Freedom Medical Supply is a family-owned medical supply and equipment retailer based in Las Vegas, Nevada. The company was founded in 2004 by Brad and Gloria Maurer, longtime residents who opened the business to serve the local community with home healthcare solutions.

The store sells and rents a wide range of home healthcare equipment, including mobility aids, incontinence products, wound care supplies, compression garments, and foot care items. It carries products from brands such as Pride, Prevail, Nova, Medline, McKesson, Hollister, and 3M. The staff assists customers with insurance billing and product selection, and the facility offers an equipment rental program for short-term needs.

Freedom Medical Supply primarily serves individuals recovering from surgery, living with chronic conditions, or needing senior home care safety products in the Las Vegas and Henderson areas. Its customers include patients, caregivers, and healthcare professionals seeking reliable medical supplies for home use.

The company operates on core values of compassion, trust, innovation, excellence, and teamwork. It emphasizes hiring staff with a passion for the medical supply industry who are trained to provide knowledgeable assistance with insurance and product questions.

name: Freedom Plastic Bags Inc.
old_description: Don’t worry about “rush charges”, we do not charge extra for “rush” orders.
about:
Freedom Plastic Bags Inc. operates from Grand Forks, North Dakota. The company's founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed. It specializes in custom printed plastic bags for businesses needing quick turnaround.

The company produces custom printed plastic bags in sizes ranging from 8″ × 12″ to 24″ × 24″ × 5″, with bag colors including white, black, yellow, and clear depending on size. Printing is limited to one ink color on one or both sides, using plate sizes of approximately 5″ × 5″ to 8″ × 8″. Bag thickness runs from 2.4 to 2.9 mil. Orders start at a minimum of 100 bags, and the company emphasizes that it does not assess rush charges, though expedited shipping may be used to meet deadlines.

Customers span retail shops, trade-show exhibitors, art organizations, media outlets, and general businesses seeking branded packaging. Testimonials reference an Artists Boutique 50th-anniversary show, a radio station (WIXY1260online), and a children's logo program, illustrating use cases from event merchandise to everyday retail bags.

Freedom Plastic Bags positions itself on speed and simplicity: no rush fees, a low 100-bag minimum, and a streamlined one-color print process designed to deliver custom bags in days rather than weeks.

name: Fresca Mexican Foods
old_description: Our tortillas and wraps don’t crack (or rip, or tear) under pressure. They are built to handle all your fillings!
about:
Fresca Mexican Foods operates from Caldwell, Idaho, where it has produced tortillas, wraps, and chips since 1977. The company was acquired in 2007 by Andy Savin, a former investment banker and executive at PACCAR and RR Donnelley, who leads as president and CEO.

The SQF‑certified facility runs a proprietary fresh‑freezing process that locks in a fresh‑baked flavor while using fewer ingredients. Current output reaches roughly five million tortillas per day across flour, corn, and corn‑flour blend varieties, as well as flavored wraps and tortilla chips, supported by a workforce of more than 370 full‑time employees.

Products ship fresh‑frozen to hundreds of foodservice partners worldwide, including restaurant chains, distributors, and private‑label brands. The company emphasizes formulation matching and product innovation to meet specific customer needs, from die‑cut artisan tortillas to clean‑label lines developed over four decades.

The leadership team, including Chief Revenue Officer John Rosellini, frames the business around long‑term partnerships and continuous improvement in quality and consistency.

name: Fresh Mode Screen Printing
old_description: Endless possibilities for creative textures, colors, and designs
about:
Fresh Mode Screen Printing operates from North Kingstown, Rhode Island. The company was founded in 2006, beginning with a single press and dryer in a 1,200-square-foot shop. Ownership details and founder names are not disclosed in the source material.

The shop provides screen printing, embroidery, and contract printing services, running all production on-site in a 10,000-square-foot facility. Capabilities include custom decoration of T-shirts, sweatshirts, sport shirts, bags, pants, hats, and other apparel. The company describes its capacity as large but does not publish specific volume figures or headcount.

Fresh Mode serves the retail industry through contract services and also works directly with businesses, sports teams, event organizers, schools, charities, and fundraisers. It positions itself as a commercial screen printing source for companies throughout Rhode Island.

The company emphasizes clear communication and on-time delivery, stating that 100 percent of projects are completed on or before the customer's deadline. In-house silk screening gives it full control over quality, and it rewards repeat customers with fair pricing.

name: Frontgrade Colorado Springs LLC
old_description: Precision motion control systems and electronics engineered for reliable positioning, stabilization, and actuation in the harshest environments.
about:
Frontgrade Colorado Springs LLC operates from Colorado Springs, Colorado, drawing on more than six decades of heritage in harsh-environment electronics. The company traces its lineage to technologies that have supported every crewed U.S. space mission from Apollo 11 through Artemis II, though a specific founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed.

The company designs and manufactures precision motion control systems and electronics, including circuit card assemblies, cable assemblies, radiation-hardened products, and solar array drive assemblies. Its capabilities span RF systems, mission processing, microelectronics, motion control, advanced engineering solutions, and manufacturing solutions. Details on facility size, headcount, or production volumes are not provided.

Frontgrade serves defense and aerospace customers across space systems, radar, communications, electronic warfare, intelligence-surveillance-reconnaissance (ISR), and missile and precision strike programs. Its components have been integrated into every crewed U.S. spaceflight since 1969, as well as numerous defense platforms.

The company emphasizes reliability, producibility, and adaptability for missions that cannot fail, positioning its broad portfolio and engineering expertise as a way to reduce complexity and accelerate fielding of mission-ready capability.

name: Frontier Home Medical Inc
old_description: Come to us for respiratory support and medical devices for complex pulmonary and sleep care.
about:
Frontier Home Medical began in 1998 in Cozad, Nebraska, as a family-owned provider of medical equipment services to nearby communities. The company has since expanded to seven locations across the state and is now headquartered in Omaha, Nebraska, remaining under family ownership.

The company supplies a range of durable medical equipment and related services, including respiratory therapy devices such as oxygen concentrators, CPAP/BiPAP machines, and nebulizers; mobility equipment from canes to power wheelchairs; home safety products like ramps, stair glides, and hospital beds; incontinence supplies; nutritional supplements; diabetic footwear; and pediatric medical equipment. Frontier operates through its seven retail locations and works directly with healthcare providers to fit and deliver equipment to patients.

Frontier serves patients, physicians, and healthcare providers throughout Nebraska and western Iowa. Its customer base includes individuals with complex pulmonary and sleep conditions, mobility impairments, incontinence needs, and nutritional deficiencies, as well as infants and children requiring specialized equipment.

The company emphasizes its family-owned structure and a mission centered on patient experience, stating that its focus is on comprehensive patient support and making home-based care as convenient as possible.

about:
Based in Warwick, Rhode Island, Frugal Furniture operates six showrooms across the region, offering a range of residential furnishings. The company's history and founding year are not publicly disclosed, and ownership details have not been specified.

The retailer carries living room, dining room, bedroom, mattress, home office, and outdoor collections, emphasizing in-stock inventory so customers can shop, test, and take delivery without extended lead times. Financing and lease-to-own programs are available to accommodate different budgets.

Frugal Furniture serves primarily residential consumers, with showrooms designed for hands-on evaluation of sectional sofas, recliners, dining sets, and bedroom suites. The product assortment includes brands such as Dramatic, Edenfield, Emilia, First Base, Fyne-Dyme, Koralynn, Lavenhorne, Lindyn, and Mahoney, though the company does not manufacture these lines itself.

The business highlights local service and immediate availability as its primary differentiators, promoting a "where quality meets value" proposition backed by multiple physical locations.

name: Fuji Electric Corp. of America
old_description: When you work with Fuji Electric, you aren’t just getting a power electronics manufacturer of
about:
Fuji Electric Corp. of America is headquartered in Roanoke, Virginia, and operates as the U.S. subsidiary of Fuji Electric Co., Ltd., a Japanese multinational founded in 1923. The global enterprise began over a century ago with a focus on advanced engineering and industrial power solutions, expanding to 177 offices worldwide and a workforce of approximately 26,955 employees.

The company manufactures a broad range of power electronics equipment, including AC drives (such as the FRENIC-MEGA G2 series), semiconductors, instrumentation, blowers, fans, pumps, human-machine interfaces (HMIs), uninterruptible power supplies (UPS), and oil-immersed transformers. Its portfolio spans power generation, distribution and control, transit systems, and photoconductor technologies, supported by global engineering and application expertise.

Fuji Electric serves customers across diverse sectors: oil and gas (upstream, midstream, downstream), data centers (cooling, power, AI infrastructure), manufacturing facilities, utilities, infrastructure, healthcare, HVAC, water treatment, renewable energy, and transportation. Its client base includes OEMs, system integrators, engineers, contractors, utilities, and distributors who rely on the company's technical support from specification through operation.

The company emphasizes that its differentiation lies in consistent global quality standards—enforced identically at every manufacturing site—and a commitment to innovation that targets energy efficiency, productivity gains, reduced downtime, and long-term sustainability. It positions itself as a long-term partner, offering responsive technical support and dependable solutions engineered for real-world reliability.
